easyPrerequisites: There are at least 5 tapped lands on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Ignition Team by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Ignition Team enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Ignition Team enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Ignition Team.
Activate Ignition Team using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
